page.body:
Creating an account

Estimated reading: 2 minutes 829 views

Creating a PropertyList account is a simple and straightforward process that can be completed in just a few minutes. Make sure your admin of the company opens the first account and then adds employees within the platform, this way you can keep track of all the contacts, events, pipeline and more of the whole company. To get started, follow these steps

  • Go to the https://PropertyList.es/
  • Click the “Sign Up” button.
  • Fill in your agency details

Click “Next”.

  • Add your agency’s website domain.
  • Choose your primary language.
  • Upload your company logo and an office photo.

Click “Next”.

  • Add your Admin User Account information.

Click “Next”.

  • Add your XML Import Feed. Need to upload your direct listings in bulk? Our system works with all major platforms, so integration should be easy! (optional) 
  • Agree to the terms of service and privacy policy.
 
Once your account is created you can share your properties with other agents and link all the properties to your website and much more!
 
NOTE: We recommend using the XML feed first to get your initial properties uploaded. Then, as you acquire new listings, you can manually add them directly to PropertyList MLS for maximum control.
– We offer the same link for you to provide to other platforms, find out more here: XML Export.
 
 
Next be sure to add your Staff/Employees, this will send them a link to join for free also within the agency.
